title: 2306 Wooster St, Nolanville, TX | Elizabeth Thomas ACE Real Estate Group | Nolanville TX Real Estate
description:
This stunning 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath house in the Enclave Subdivision boasts tons of upgrades! Walk in and be greeted by decorative tilework, a tongue and groove ceiling, and a living room featuring coffered ceilings. The kitchen is a chef's dream with double built-in ovens, ample cabinet space with an island, granite countertops, tile backsplash, and a large sink with a view of the backyard. The master suite features a beautiful accent wall, a spacious walk-in closet, a large soaking tub, and a walk-through shower. This house has it all: open floorpan, decorative ceilings, accent walls, a built-in toolbox in the garage, a screened-in back porch for relaxing evenings, and ceiling fans in all secondary bedrooms. Don't miss out on this beauty!

-

I’m Elizabeth Thomas, your go-to 28-year-old Realtor with a passion for making dreams come true in the Lone Star State! When I’m not working for you, you can find me relaxing with my dog Tux. 🐶


In 2018 the military brought me to Fort Hood / Fort Cavazos, and it’s been an incredible journey. As a real estate professional, I’ve had the privilege of helping HUNDREDS of families find their perfect homes and navigate the exciting world of real estate. 🗝
Originally from North Carolina, I carry the warmth of Southern hospitality in my heart and the determination to go the extra mile for my clients. 💖 Whether you’re an investor seeking prime opportunities, a first-time buyer, a seller aiming to make a profitable move, or a fellow military family in need of a seamless transition, I’m here to serve and support you every step of the way. 🤝
